_comment: PREFERRED PLAYER CARD — the whole rewards program lives in this one file.
Edit, restart the server, done. Nothing here is hard-coded anywhere else.
POS INTEGRATIONS:
Billiards POS: CueT POS (Table rentals, hourly rates, player time tracking)
Bar POS: Toast (bar & food checks)
EARNING (approved Sept 2026):
earn.perTableHour 5 means 1 hour on the table = 5 points.
earn.perDollar 0.2 means bar & food tabs earn 1 point per $5, rounded down per check.
Change this ONE number to change the bar rate (0 or delete it = bar tabs earn nothing).
Table rental dollars never earn dollar points — table time earns per hour only.
earn.perTipDollar 0.2 means TIPS earn 1 point per $5 tipped, rounded down per check, on their own
(separate from perDollar; the tip is never counted inside the bar subtotal). 0 = tips earn nothing.
earn.tablePunchCycle 11 means bank 10 hours — the 11th table hour is FREE.
WHY 1 POINT PER $5 ON BAR TABS:
Table time at the default $15/hr earns 5 points = 1 point per $3.
The only reward is free table time, worth about $15 per 250 points (~6 cents a point).
So bar spend gives back ~1.2% versus ~2% for table time: table time stays the main
driver, and every redemption costs the bar only idle table time, never product.
REWARDS: free table time ONLY. Every reward must have "type": "table" — the server
refuses to start otherwise, and never redeems anything else.
REDEMPTION CODES (free table time):
redeemCodes.posExpiryHours 24: a code printed by the POS / register lasts this long.
redeemCodes.memberExpiryMinutes 15: a code a member makes in the app lasts this long.
redeemCodes.maxOpenPosCodes 2: most register / 'Code for later' codes one member can have open.
(App codes: one at a time — a new one replaces the old one.)
Making a code HOLDS its points at once (available = balance - held). They come off when the
Front Desk redeems the code, and are released if it expires or a manager cancels it.
Each code works once.
TIER OVERRIDES:
tierOverride.expiryMonths 12: a tier a manager sets by hand lasts this many months, then the
member goes back to the tier their lifetime points earn. Setting it again restarts the clock.
TIPS vs SERVICE CHARGES:
Only a real tip (Toast 'tip' / 'tipAmount') earns tip points. An automatic service charge or
auto-gratuity ('gratuity', 'serviceCharge', 'autoGratuity' ...) earns nothing; it is noted in the POS log.
OFF ON PURPOSE: no birthday bonus, weekday multiplier or visit streak. Leave
birthdayBonus, multiplier/multiplierDays and visitStreakCount/visitStreakBonus unset.

terms: Free to join. Ask at the Front Desk for your Preferred Player Card.
Earn 5 points per table hour, 1 point per $5 on bar tabs (before tax and tip) and 1 point per $5 tipped (each rounded down per check).
In The 11th Hour punch card: bank 10 paid table hours and your 11th hour is 100% free. Redeem at the Front Desk.
Rewards are free table time only; no bar or food redemptions. No cash value. Non-transferable.
Must be 21+ with valid ID. Breaker Billiards reserves the right to modify or end this program at any time.
